recommended_integration.downloads: Run song-download/qq-music via skill_run with requests and private API configuration; save into existing persistent /workspaces/folotoy/music.
recommended_integration.media_sharing: Bind the matching host directory into FoloToy read-only; transcode in FoloToy using existing ffmpeg and serve resulting audio through its LAN-accessible HTTP service.
recommended_integration.playback: Add an authenticated, turn-associated playback queue to FoloToy. Carry device/request context from the voice turn, append music after TTS, and coordinate cancellation instead of independently publishing legacy playback messages.
recommended_integration.opencli: Configure built-in host_opencli to a fixed container proxy; proxy calls a token-protected gen-user host bridge that runs the installed OpenCLI with its existing HOME and browser extension.
recommended_integration.native_config: Explicit sandbox.allow_host_tools=true and host_opencli.executable proxy path; keep WS/fullAccess.
recommended_integration.credentials: Remove embedded credentials from migrated skill text/scripts; retain only private runtime configuration.
recommended_integration.core_changes: No Go/Rust core change expected; skill scripts, runtime/deployment, host bridge and a small FoloToy playback integration are required.

scope: Read-only assessment and two music search queries only; no music download, no playback command, no daemon start, and no production configuration changes.
